title: Team artifact install doesn't auto-instantiate — ensemble actors resolve only instantiated teams
wanted_capability: Ensemble actors resolve `team` via load_team (instantiated teams store) with no teamplate fallback, so adopting an ensemble requires `bro_team(action=create, name, template)` after installing the teamplate — bbox_artifact_install kind=team and save_template are NOT sufficient, nor is a daemon restart. Want: auto-instantiate on team-artifact install, or codify the create step in the adoption runbook so the footgun dies. (The design doc was updated with the manual sequence; the substrate-level fix is still open.)
fallback_used: Manual bro_team(action=create) after artifact install, documented in the ensemble design doc
notes: Extracted from thread-cc07f395 item 5 during thread triage.
resolution_note: Team artifact install now materializes (operator-selected: instantiate-at-install): ArtifactKind::Team install parses the artifact as a Teamplate, validates member brofiles exist (fail-loud at install, parity with agent installs), writes the teamplate store, and instantiates the team under the teamplate's own name — so ensemble actors (load_team, no fallback) dispatch immediately after install. Guard rails: re-install never clobbers a live team (member sessions preserved; refreshed teamplate picked up by future creates); advisor-carrying teamplates are rejected at install (advisor init needs a live dispatch — bro_team create remains their path); boot restore deliberately excludes Team so dissolution sticks. Shipped system-defaults/agentic-corpus/teams/contradiction-specialists.json with aliases provenance/lifecycle/coherence matching contradiction-review-arc's whiteboard registrations (install-teams.sh's generated m1/m2/m3 names did not — script marked legacy).
